title: IBM MQ — Unified Observability
description: Everything about the IBM MQ lab on one board, in the pack's order: SLIs and SLOs, MTTD/MTTR and certification, policy and alerting, remediation, signals, pipeline, logs and traces.

options.content:
### IBM MQ · Unified Observability
One board in the pack's own order: SLIs and SLOs, the validation that proves them (MTTD, MTTR, certification), policy and alerting, remediation, the signals underneath, the pipeline, logs and traces.  ·  pack `ibmmq@0.2.0`  ·  **Unified** · [Overview](/d/ibmmq-overview?${__url_time_range}) · [Queues & channels](/d/ibmmq-queues?${__url_time_range}) · [SLO burn](/d/ibmmq-slo-burn?${__url_time_range})

panels.title: Process up
panels.description: 5-minute fraction of scrapes in which the queue manager's native metrics endpoint answered. SLO 99.9 % over 30 d.

panels.title: Reachable
panels.description: 5-minute fraction of samples in which an MQ client (the exporter over DEV.ADMIN.SVRCONN) saw the queue manager RUNNING. Diverges from "process up" on listener, channel, CHLAUTH or CONNAUTH faults.

panels.title: Queue headroom
panels.description: Highest depth / MAXDEPTH across application queues. 100 % means producers get MQRC_Q_FULL (2053).

panels.title: Oldest message
panels.description: Age of the oldest message on any application queue (DLQ excluded). Consumer health.

panels.title: DLQ depth
panels.description: Messages on the queue manager's dead-letter queue (APP.DLQ).

panels.title: Canary success
panels.description: 5-minute success ratio of the synthetic put→get probe on APP.CANARY (matching payload within 5 s).

panels.title: Canary p99
panels.description: p99 put→get round-trip of successful probes over 5 minutes (connect time excluded).

panels.title: Log write latency
panels.description: Recovery-log write latency reported by the queue manager. Persistent-message throughput depends on it.

panels.title: Error-budget burn · last hour
panels.description: 1 h error-budget burn rate per SLO: 1× consumes the budget exactly over the SLO window; amber at the smallest factor that alerts for that SLO, red at the largest (spec.policy).

panels.title: Burn rate · 5 m window
panels.description: Fast window: reacts within minutes; pages when both it and the slow window exceed the factor. Hover for per-SLO values.

panels.title: Burn rate · 1 h window
panels.description: Slow window: keeps burning for up to an hour after an incident by design.

panels.title: Last certification
panels.description: Verdict of the last `npm run certify` published to the alert-sink: PASS, WARN, FAIL or ERROR.

panels.title: Certified
panels.description: When the last certification run finished.

panels.title: MTTD p50
panels.description: Median time from fault injection to the alert webhook, across every expected alert of the chaos suite. Baseline p50 1 min (pack spec.baselines).

panels.title: MTTD p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time to detect. Baseline p95 2 min.

panels.title: MTTR p50 · resolution
panels.description: Median time from the recovery action to the resolved webhook: the observability system's share of MTTR (it excludes the human/automation fix time). Baseline MTTR p50 15 min.

panels.title: MTTR p95 · resolution
panels.description: 95th percentile resolution after recovery. Baseline MTTR p95 45 min.

panels.title: MTTD per expected alert · against its budget
panels.description: Time from injection to the firing webhook for each expected alert in the last run; amber from 75 % of the experiment's expected_mttd, red at the budget.

panels.title: Resolution after recovery · per alert
panels.description: Time from the recovery action to the resolved webhook in the last run (Prometheus resolve + Alertmanager group_interval + webhook).

panels.title: Conformance passed
panels.description: C1-C10: does the stack implement the pack?

panels.title: Synthetic passed
panels.description: S1-S6: canary, orders flow, no symptom or fast-window burn alert firing.

panels.title: Chaos passed
panels.description: Experiments whose alerts fired within budget, resolved after recovery, and whose hypothesis SLI moved as declared.

panels.title: Webhooks in the ledger
panels.description: Alertmanager webhook events held by the alert-sink (MTTD is measured from their receipt time).

panels.title: §10 · Validation — synthetic canary and orders flow

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", pack="ibmmq", burn_rate="", kind=""}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Symptom alerts · pending / firing
panels.description: State of every symptom alert of the pack over the time range.

targets.expr: (2 * max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="ibmmq", alertstate="firing", burn_rate="", kind=""})) or max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="ibmmq", alertstate="pending", burn_rate="", kind=""}) or label_replace(vector(0), "alertname", "no alert", "", "")

panels.title: Firing pack alerts
panels.description: Everything currently firing with the pack label, most severe first.

panels.title: Burn-rate & forecast alerts · pending / firing
panels.description: Multi-window burn-rate alerts (fast windows page, slow windows linger after incidents) and forecasts.

targets.expr: (2 * max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="ibmmq", alertstate="firing", burn_rate!=""})) or max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="ibmmq", alertstate="pending", burn_rate!=""}) or label_replace(vector(0), "alertname", "no alert", "", "")
(2 * max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="ibmmq", alertstate="firing", kind="forecast"})) or max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="ibmmq", alertstate="pending", kind="forecast"})

options.content:
| Trigger | Runbook | Automation (declared) | Guardrails (declared) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ibmmq-queue-manager-down` | [qmgr-down.md](https://github.com/MoebiusX/mq-observability-pack/blob/main/runbooks/qmgr-down.md) | `restart-qmgr-with-nha-quorum-check` | ≤ 2/h · human above SEV1 · cooldown 30m |
| `ibmmq-queue-manager-unreachable` | [qmgr-unreachable.md](https://github.com/MoebiusX/mq-observability-pack/blob/main/runbooks/qmgr-unreachable.md) | `start-listener-and-channels` | ≤ 3/h · human above SEV1 · cooldown 15m |
| `ibmmq-queue-full` | [queue-depth.md](https://github.com/MoebiusX/mq-observability-pack/blob/main/runbooks/queue-depth.md) | `consumer-scale-out` | ≤ 3/h · human above SEV1 · cooldown 15m |
| `ibmmq-oldest-message-age-high` | [consumer-stalled.md](https://github.com/MoebiusX/mq-observability-pack/blob/main/runbooks/consumer-stalled.md) | `consumer-scale-out` | ≤ 3/h · human above SEV2 · cooldown 15m |
| `ibmmq-dead-letter-queue-not-empty` | [dlq.md](https://github.com/MoebiusX/mq-observability-pack/blob/main/runbooks/dlq.md) | `manual-only` | ≤ 1/h · human above SEV3 |

<small>Automations and guardrails come from the pack's `remediation` section for the platform to implement; in this lab every action is done by hand, as the runbooks say.</small>

panels.title: Queue manager
panels.description: Status as seen by an MQ client over DEV.ADMIN.SVRCONN.

panels.title: Native endpoint
panels.description: Scrape of the queue manager's own :9157 endpoint (process alive).

panels.title: Exporter scrape
panels.description: Scrape of mq_prometheus (queue/channel detail; dies with the listener).

panels.title: Availability timeline
panels.description: Process alive vs reachable by clients, plus the command server and channel initiator. The differential diagnosis, over time.

panels.title: Headroom by queue · depth / MAXDEPTH
panels.description: Current depth as a fraction of MAXDEPTH per application queue.

panels.title: Put / get rate by queue
panels.description: MQI counts are per-interval deltas from the exporter: sum over 2 m ÷ 120 s.

panels.title: Queue snapshot
panels.description: Depth, MAXDEPTH, oldest message age and open handles per queue, right now.

panels.title: Open handles by queue · in / out
Channel status
panels.description: Squashed channel status per channel.

panels.title: Channel instances
panels.description: One instance per client conversation on a SVRCONN channel.

panels.title: Channel messages / s
panels.description: Per-interval channel message counts, sum over 2 m ÷ 120 s.

panels.title: Channel bytes / s · sent and received
Failed MQI calls / s · expired messages
Recovery log written / s · logical vs physical
Recovery log · write latency and space in use
TSDB series
panels.description: Active series in Prometheus (2 d retention in the lab).

panels.title: Recording rules producing
panels.description: Distinct ibmmq:* recording-rule series currently produced (pack queries + generated error-budget rules).

panels.title: Collector · export failures per second
panels.description: The failure counters only exist once a batch has failed; a flat zero is the collector saying nothing has.

panels.title: Logs · queue manager and apps
panels.description: Filter with the "Log service" variable. App lines carry trace_id / span_id; click a line to jump to its trace.

panels.title: Recent traces · producer → consumer through MQ
panels.description: Open a consumer "receive" span: its link points at the producer trace whose context travelled in the message properties.
